briefs.brief_cn: Eaton 的核心卡点在数据中心从电网接入到机柜供电之间的电气链条，包括开关柜、配电、UPS/电力管理和数据中心电气系统。缓存证据显示其 Q1 2026 Electrical Americas 订单动能强，数据中心订单约增长 240%，说明需求并非只停留在 AI 叙事，而是进入可追踪的订单和积压环节。该标的的研究重点不是“是否受益于数据中心”，而是要拆清楚真正稀缺的开关柜/配电/电力链收入占比，与普通电气周期上行的区别。若后续订单增速放缓、book-to-bill 回落、交付周期缩短但收入和利润没有继续释放，或竞争者产能扩张快速缓解供给紧张，则该卡点 thesis 应降级。下一步重点跟踪 Electrical Americas 订单、积压订单、分部利润率、交期评论、数据中心客户订单占比和管理层对开关柜/配电供需的表述。
briefs.brief_en: Eaton is mapped to the grid-to-rack electrical bottleneck for AI and data-center buildouts: switchgear, power distribution, UPS/power-management equipment, and broader data-center electrical systems. Provided cached evidence states that Q1 2026 Electrical Americas orders were strong and data-center orders grew by roughly 240%, making the thesis trackable through orders, backlog, book-to-bill, segment margin, and lead-time commentary. The key research question is not whether Eaton has data-center exposure, but how much of the upside is tied to genuinely scarce switchgear and power-chain capacity rather than a broad electrical upcycle. The thesis would weaken if order growth decelerates, book-to-bill normalizes, lead times compress without revenue/margin follow-through, or competitor capacity additions quickly remove scarcity.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: Eaton is a high-purity public-market proxy for scarce data-center electrical infrastructure, especially switchgear and power distribution that can delay energization even when compute hardware and interconnection approvals are available.
evidence_to_verify: Provided cached evidence: Q1 2026 Electrical Americas order momentum was strong.
Provided cached evidence: data-center orders grew approximately 240%.
Verify product-level mix: how much revenue and backlog are from switchgear, power distribution, UPS, busway, and other data-center electrical systems.
Verify customer-level concentration and whether orders are tied to hyperscalers, colocation operators, utilities, or EPC/channel partners.
Check latest filings and earnings-call transcripts for backlog, book-to-bill, lead-time, pricing, and segment-margin commentary.
falsification: Electrical Americas orders or backlog roll over materially while data-center commentary weakens.
Book-to-bill falls below expansionary levels for multiple quarters.
Lead times shorten because supply catches up, but revenue and margin do not inflect.
Growth is shown to be mostly broad electrical-cycle strength rather than scarce data-center switchgear/power-chain content.
Pricing power fades or margin expansion stalls despite backlog conversion.
monitoring_items: Electrical Americas orders and backlog
Data-center order growth and mix disclosure
Book-to-bill ratio
Switchgear, power distribution, UPS, and busway lead times
Segment operating margin and pricing commentary
Capacity additions and competitor supply response
Large hyperscaler, colocation, utility, or EPC-related order announcements

briefs.brief_cn: GE Vernova 的卡点覆盖面更广，横跨变压器、开关柜、变电站、HVDC、电网现代化和燃气发电。缓存证据显示其 Q1 2026 Electrification 设备订单中有 24 亿美元与数据中心相关，同时还有 Prolec GE 变压器扩产和燃气电力 slot reservation 线索。它的优势是同时踩中电网扩容和数据中心新增负荷两个方向，但研究难点是区分数据中心驱动的 backlog 与传统公用事业电网投资、工业电气化或周期性设备需求。若变压器/电网设备扩产明显快于需求、数据中心订单占比低于预期、燃气机组预留不能转化为正式订单，或 backlog 转收入和利润率不及预期，则 thesis 需要降级。下一步应跟踪 Electrification 设备订单、数据中心相关 backlog、Prolec GE 扩产节奏、gas power slot 转订单率、HVDC/变电站项目进展和分部利润率兑现。
briefs.brief_en: GE Vernova spans several scarce nodes in the AI-power buildout: transformers, switchgear, substations, HVDC, grid modernization, and gas-power generation. Provided cached evidence notes $2.4 billion of Q1 2026 Electrification equipment orders tied to data centers, plus Prolec GE transformer expansion and gas-power slot reservations. The thesis is powerful because data-center load growth can stress both the grid-equipment layer and dispatchable-generation layer. The main research problem is attribution: how much backlog is truly data-center-driven versus broader utility grid modernization or industrial electrification. The thesis would weaken if transformer and grid-equipment capacity expands faster than demand, gas-power reservations fail to convert into firm orders, or backlog conversion and margins disappoint.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: GE Vernova is a multi-node AI-power bottleneck candidate because data-center load growth requires grid equipment, transformers, substations, HVDC, and often new or reserved gas-power capacity.
evidence_to_verify: Provided cached evidence: Q1 2026 Electrification equipment orders included $2.4 billion tied to data centers.
Provided cached evidence: Prolec GE transformer expansion is relevant to transformer supply.
Provided cached evidence: gas-power slot reservations are part of the thesis.
Verify backlog segmentation between data-center demand, utility grid modernization, industrial electrification, and other customers.
Verify transformer, switchgear, HVDC, and gas-turbine capacity expansion timelines and margin assumptions.
falsification: Data-center-related orders prove to be a small or non-recurring share of backlog.
Transformer and grid-equipment capacity additions reduce lead times faster than expected.
Gas-power slot reservations do not convert into binding orders or revenue.
Electrification backlog grows but margins fail to improve due to execution, cost inflation, or low-margin mix.
Utility/regulatory constraints delay project awards, interconnections, or grid buildout.
monitoring_items: Electrification equipment orders
Data-center-specific order and backlog commentary
Transformer lead times and Prolec GE capacity additions
HVDC, substation, and grid-modernization project awards
Gas Power slot reservations and conversion to firm orders
Backlog conversion cadence
Segment margins and execution costs
Utility interconnection and grid capex approvals

briefs.brief_cn: AEP 是需求侧和电网接入侧的清晰映射，重点在于大型数据中心负荷能否从申请、研究、签约进一步变成已送电负荷、获批资本开支和可回收收益。缓存证据显示 AEP Ohio 已有获批的数据中心 tariff、绑定合同和分批负荷研究流程，并且截至 2026 年 2 月 12 日，AEP Ohio 从早期超过 30,000 MW 的申请转为 5,642 MW 的已签 binding contracts。该 thesis 的优势是可证伪性强：MW 承诺、minimum bill、互联里程碑、监管批复和 rate base 增长都能跟踪。主要风险是客户取消或推迟项目、监管机构限制成本回收、地方电网升级周期长、或新增负荷无法按预期转化为实际用电和收益。下一步应跟踪绑定 MW、已送电 MW、数据中心 tariff 执行、资本开支获批、客户预付款/担保、监管听证和负荷预测修正。
briefs.brief_en: AEP is one of the cleanest demand-side mappings for the AI/data-center power theme because its thesis can be tracked from requested load to binding contracts, interconnection milestones, approved capex, energized load, and regulated cost recovery. Provided cached evidence states that AEP Ohio has an approved data-center tariff, binding contracts, and tranche-based load-study processes. It also states that AEP Ohio moved from more than 30,000 MW of earlier requests to 5,642 MW of signed binding contracts as of February 12, 2026. The key issue is conversion quality: whether contracted MW becomes energized load and rate-base growth without major regulatory pushback. The thesis would weaken if customers defer projects, minimum-bill protections are not enforced, regulators restrict cost recovery, or grid upgrades take longer than expected.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: AEP is a regulated-utility proxy for the data-center load bottleneck: scarce grid capacity, interconnection processing, required transmission/distribution upgrades, and tariff-based cost recovery for large new loads.
evidence_to_verify: Provided cached evidence: AEP Ohio has an approved data-center tariff.
Provided cached evidence: AEP Ohio uses binding contracts and tranche-based load-study processes.
Provided cached evidence: as of February 12, 2026, AEP Ohio had 5,642 MW of signed binding contracts versus more than 30,000 MW of earlier requests.
Verify how much of the signed MW is backed by deposits, minimum bills, credit support, or other enforceable customer obligations.
Verify regulatory treatment for data-center-driven transmission, distribution, and generation-related capex.
falsification: Signed MW commitments fail to convert into energized load.
Customers defer, resize, or cancel data-center projects despite binding-contract language.
Regulators disallow or delay cost recovery for grid upgrades tied to data centers.
Minimum-bill or customer-contribution mechanisms prove weaker than expected.
Capex rises but allowed returns, rate-base growth, or earnings contribution disappoint.
Load growth creates reliability or political backlash that slows approvals.
monitoring_items: Signed binding MW commitments
Energized MW and interconnection milestones
AEP Ohio data-center tariff proceedings
Minimum-bill enforcement and customer credit support
Transmission and distribution capex approvals
Rate-base growth and allowed returns
Regulatory orders, intervenor objections, and cost-allocation debates
Updates to utility load forecasts

briefs.brief_cn: TSMC 是 AI 算力产业链的核心制造和先进封装节点，卡点主要在领先制程晶圆产能与 CoWoS 等先进封装能力。逻辑上，主流 AI 加速器需求必须经过领先制程代工和高带宽内存相关先进封装，因此其瓶颈属性强；但该方向已经高度可见，市场预期可能已充分反映。与前三个电力链候选不同，TSMC 的主要研究难点不是证明其产业链地位，而是验证新增 CoWoS/先进封装产能、客户分配、价格和 AI 需求持续性是否仍超出预期。若 AI 加速器需求放缓、客户库存修正、先进封装产能快速释放导致供需不再紧张、价格/毛利率承压，或地缘政治风险扰动订单和产能布局，则 thesis 应降级。下一步应跟踪 CoWoS 产能、先进封装 capex、HPC/AI 收入占比、主要客户订单、毛利率、产能利用率和市场对 AI 峰值需求的定价。
briefs.brief_en: TSMC is the central manufacturing and advanced-packaging node for leading-edge AI accelerators. The chokepoint is clear: much of the AI accelerator supply chain must pass through leading-edge foundry capacity and advanced packaging such as CoWoS. However, the setup is already highly visible, so the research burden is to test whether capacity expansion, customer allocation, pricing, and AI-demand durability still exceed market expectations. The thesis would weaken if AI accelerator demand slows, customers enter inventory correction, advanced-packaging capacity catches up faster than expected, pricing or gross margin deteriorates, or geopolitical risks disrupt orders and capacity planning.
briefs.chokepoint_thesis: TSMC is a high-scarcity AI compute bottleneck because leading-edge AI accelerators depend on its foundry capacity and advanced-packaging ecosystem, but the public-market setup may already price much of this scarcity.
evidence_to_verify: Provided cached evidence: TSMC is positioned as a central manufacturing and advanced-packaging node for leading-edge AI accelerators.
Verify current CoWoS and other advanced-packaging capacity expansion plans.
Verify customer allocation among major AI accelerator vendors and hyperscaler ASIC programs.
Verify pricing, gross-margin, utilization, and capex guidance tied to HPC/AI demand.
Verify whether market expectations already discount peak AI growth and packaging scarcity.
falsification: CoWoS or advanced-packaging supply expands fast enough to remove scarcity.
AI accelerator orders slow or customers reduce forecasts.
HPC/AI revenue growth decelerates materially versus expectations.
Gross margin weakens due to depreciation, pricing pressure, or lower utilization.
Major customers dual-source, redesign, or shift packaging flows in ways that reduce TSMC bottleneck control.
Geopolitical or export-control risks impair production, customer demand, or capacity deployment.
monitoring_items: CoWoS and advanced-packaging capacity additions
Advanced-packaging capex and equipment lead times
HPC/AI revenue growth and customer mix
Major AI accelerator tape-outs and volume ramps
Gross margin, utilization, and pricing commentary
HBM packaging ecosystem constraints
Customer inventory signals
Geopolitical, export-control, and Taiwan capacity-diversification developments
